versions.content: The user of the CanTrcv module shall call the function CanTrcv_SetOpMode with OpMode = CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_STANDBY or CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_NORMAL, if the Transceiver is in mode CANTRCV_TRCVMODE_NORMAL.
